_note: Text models are priced per token. Image and video models return no token counts, so they are priced per call: one image per image call, and one 8-second 16:9 clip per Veo call (pipeline/gtm_creative/motion.py sets DURATION_S = 8, sampleCount = 1). If the clip length or sample count changes, veo per_call must change with it.

gemini-3.8-flash._valid: these are the published rates through 2026-12-31; they double to 1.50 / 7.50 on 2027-01-01

veo-3.1-generate-001._basis: $0.40 per second, Standard (720p and 1080p are the same price) x 8 seconds x 1 sample.
